LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_BenchQueuedText: The bills are still queued on it. The last one is for a meal, and there is nothing in this space to cook.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_BenchHandedText: Worn down on the left side only. Everyone who ever stood at this bench stood the same way.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_BenchClampedText: Something is still clamped in it, with the cut started and never finished.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_BenchOurMarksText: The tool marks on it match the ones on the bench the branch uses at home.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_SeatWornText: Worn through from years of sitting. The floor in front of it has no wear at all.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_SeatFacingText: Turned to face the wall. So is every other seat in this space.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_TableRingsText: Cup rings across the top, all of them the same size, and not one of them overlapping another.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_TableSetText: Laid for four, four of everything, and one of the places is sized for a child.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_BedHandbookText: Made up with the corners folded the way the company handbook specifies.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_BedImpressionText: Slept in. The impression left in it belongs to somebody much shorter than the bed.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_StorageSortedText: Emptied out, and whoever emptied it put the containers back in order afterwards.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_StorageDatedText: Labelled in the branch's own filing format, under a date that has not come yet.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_LightSwitchedText: The switch was found in the off position. The bulb is still warm.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_LightReplacedText: Replaced recently. The one it replaced is standing beside it, undamaged and working.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_ItemCountedText: Counted out into a stack, with the count written beside it. The count is correct.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_ItemPackedText: Packed for carrying and then set down. There is nowhere in this space to carry it to.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_EquipmentFittedText: Taken in at the seams to fit somebody. Nobody on the crew is that size.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_EquipmentKeptText: Cleaned and oiled on a schedule, and never once used for anything.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_AnyDustText: There is dust on everything in this space except this.
LanguageData.RR_FixtureTell_AnyMovedText: Standing a short way from the four clean marks its own feet left.
